management_text: Three equal units. Unit 1 exits TP1 7615.30 (+51.90 pts, +1R). Unit 2 exits TP2 7667.20 (+103.80 pts, +2R); on that fill Unit 3 stop moves to entry + 0.2R = 7573.78 (+10.38 pts). rationale: Reference close: 7563.40, the settled cash-session close (16:30-23:00 broker = 09:30-16:00 ET) of Monday 15 June 2026, the last completed session strictly before D = Tuesday 16 June 2026. That basis is the one the report itself declares in its Market Definition section ('regular cash session, pre/after-market excluded'); the full-broker-day close on the same date is 7559.40 and is not used. The report's own price table is built on Friday 12 June (7431.46) and is one full session stale - 131.94 pts below the slice's D-1 close - so every level here is taken from the slice, not from that table. ATR14 = 101.49 index points, 14 completed cash sessions ending 15 Jun 2026, true range = max(H-L, |H-Cprev|, |L-Cprev|); the report never states an ATR(14) number and its implied ~94.7 proxy is a 5-session figure and is discarded. Weekly pivots from the last completed week 08-12 Jun (H 7486.40, L 7243.10, C 7431.90): P 7387.13, R1 7531.17, S1 7287.87. Entry: MARKET, so entry = the reference close exactly, 7563.40. Stop: the tighter of the 5-day swing low 7243.10 (09 Jun 2026 cash low) and the nearest support, less a 0.25xATR14 buffer. Nearest support is daily S1 7536.87, which sits 3.27 pts (0.03xATR14, inside the 0.15xATR14 aggregation band) from the 15 Jun session low 7533.60 - the two aggregate as one strong-confluence support shelf, and the pivot is the named anchor. Stop = 7536.87 - 0.25 x 101.49 = 7536.87 - 25.37 = 7511.50. R = 7563.40 - 7511.50 = 51.90 pts = 0.51xATR14, inside the 0.3xATR14 (30.45) to 3.0xATR14 (304.47) band and well inside the 3.5xATR14 structural cap (355.21). Ladder: TP1 = entry + 1R = 7615.30 (0.51xATR14 from entry, inside the 2.5xATR14 = 253.72 reachability band); TP2 = entry + 2R = 7667.20; TP3 = the runner price cap, entry + 3xATR14 = 7867.87, or the session-close time stop, whichever comes first. TP1 at 7615.30 sits 5.63 pts above daily R2 7609.93 (0.06xATR14) - logged as a genuine confluence; TP2 7667.20 has no pivot within 0.15xATR14 and no confluence is claimed for it. No fib level is used on this card: the fib construction belongs to the Trade 3 family. Direction: the report's directional conviction is LONG at +0.44, above the 0.25 threshold, so Trade 1 is not suppressed on conviction; on the corrected D-1 basis the short-term technical input is stronger still (RSI2 on cash closes = 100.00 at 15 Jun versus the 76.2 the report states). Anchor: 09:00 broker = 07:00 UK, the value fixed in the instance in force for this run. The report logs an override of that anchor to 00:00 UK 'at user instruction'; a run-time instruction cannot re-select a fixed anchor, so the override is void and the fixed 07:00 UK anchor is restored.

management_text: SUPPRESSED - reason: regime is TRANSITION, in which Trade 2 is restricted to the breakout side identified by the Trade 3C card, and no breakout side exists because 3C is itself not eligible at D-1. rationale: This card was re-evaluated in the corroboration correction pass; it is the only record on this date that was rebuilt, and the reference close 7563.40, ATR14 101.49 and regime TRANSITION already carried on this date are reused unchanged so the file stays internally consistent. Corroboration gate - retested from this session's own input and NOT fired. The daily pivot tier is recomputed here directly from the broker execution price series, data/slices/US500/US500_upto_2026-06-15.csv (last bar 2026-06-15 23:45:00), taking the completed cash session (16:30-23:00 broker = 09:30-16:00 ET) of Monday 15 June 2026: H 7583.40 / L 7533.60 / C 7563.40. P = (H+L+C)/3 = 7560.13; R1 = 2P-L = 7586.67; R2 = P+(H-L) = 7609.93; R3 = H+2(P-L) = 7636.47; S1 = 2P-H = 7536.87; S2 = P-(H-L) = 7510.33; S3 = L-2(H-P) = 7487.07; derived midpoints R1.5 = 7598.30 and S1.5 = 7523.60. Corroboration flag on that tier: CORROBORATED - series: the US500 broker M15 price series carried in the D-1 slice; session: the 15 June 2026 cash session. It is corroborated by construction, because that series is the one an order from this card would be filled and settled against - the settlement source itself, not a secondary quote about the market - so there is nothing for a second source to corroborate it against. The weekly tier is computed from the same series over the last completed week 08-12 Jun 2026 (H 7486.40, L 7243.10, C 7431.90) and is CORROBORATED on the same footing: P 7387.13, R1 7531.17, S1 7287.87. The prior run inherited the SINGLE-SOURCE-INDICATIVE flag stated in the report's source-discipline section, but that flag describes prior-period High/Low reconstructed from session narrative in the report - a different and weaker input than the one used here - and provenance attaches to the H/L/C actually used to compute a tier, not to a figure quoted elsewhere. The flag therefore does not attach to these tiers, no accessible tier is indicative, and the all-tiers-indicative suppression trigger does not fire. The card is nevertheless still suppressed, on a different and independently valid ground. Regime on this date is TRANSITION. In TRANSITION the only permitted Trade 2 is a breakout-side entry aligned with the direction the Trade 3C breakout card identifies; a counter-side limit is suppressed rather than re-labelled, so the range-form buy limit into the 12 Jun daily S1 7398.71 that the report issued is unavailable under this regime on any reading. Trade 3C is itself not eligible at D-1: the 25-session range ending D-1 is high 7624.60 (02 Jun 2026) / low 7243.10 (09 Jun 2026), width 381.50 pts; a confirmed break needs a daily close beyond a boundary by at least 0.25xATR14 = 0.25 x 101.49 = 25.37 pts, i.e. at or above 7649.97 or at or below 7217.73; the reference close 7563.40 sits inside the range on both sides, 61.20 pts below the upper boundary and 320.30 pts above the lower. With 3C suppressed no breakout side is identified, so there is no side this card may take and it remains a suppressed row rather than a card - a card is not forced into existence to fill the gap the corroboration correction opened. A second, confirming defect on the same construction, logged so the decision is auditable: the breakout entry for this branch is the pivot plus 10 per cent of the P-to-R1 distance, 7560.13 + 0.10 x (7586.67 - 7560.13) = 7562.78, which sits 0.62 pts BELOW the reference close 7563.40, so a buy stop at that level would be on the wrong side of the D-1 close and could not be shipped in any case. Suppression tests logged with their values: pivot corroboration - all accessible tiers CORROBORATED from the execution series, NOT FIRED; breakout side available under TRANSITION - none, 3C ineligible on the confirmed-break test, FIRED (this is the operative ground); order side of the notional breakout entry against the reference close - 7562.78 vs 7563.40, would fail. No entry, stop, R or target ladder is carried. ATR14 = 101.49 index points, 14 completed cash sessions ending 15 Jun 2026, true range = max(H-L, |H-Cprev|, |L-Cprev|).
